translations.english: Watching the garden filled with trees, gateways ornamented with gold and gems, he entered through the pleasant pathways in the Ashoka garden. There were wonderful wolves and several herds of animals in the garden. Fruits dropped from trees were strewn all over.
translations.hindi: तथा अनेक प्रकार के बनैले जन्तुओं से युक्त, चुए हुए पके फलों से भरे-पूरे और सघन वृक्षों से पूर्ण, उस श्रशोक्रवाटिका में पहुंचा
